Build SunkAI, an AI video generation web app for the US market. UI in English.

Brand
• Name: SunkAI. Samurai theme: black, chrome silver, gold (#F5B400) and electric blue (#2F8CFF) accents, subtle lightning glow
• Premium dark UI, glassmorphism cards, Inter font, smooth Framer Motion transitions

Stack
• Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
• Supabase (auth, Postgres, storage for uploads and generated videos)
• Stripe for credit packs and monthly plans

Pages
• Landing: hero with a looping sample video, "Slice ideas into video" headline, examples gallery, pricing, FAQ
• Sign up / log in (email and Google)
• Studio: prompt box, mode switch (Text to Video, Image to Video), style presets (Cinematic, Anime, Ad, Vlog), aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), duration (5s, 10s), Generate button showing credit cost
• Job queue with progress status, then preview player with download and share
• My Videos gallery with filters and delete
• Billing: credit balance, buy credits, plan management
• Admin: users, jobs, credits used

Backend
• Video generation through the Vertal AI API behind a provider interface, so models can be swapped
• Async jobs with webhook or polling, retries and error messages
• Credits deducted only on successful generation
• Rate limits and basic content moderation on prompts

Deliver a working MVP with seed sample videos on the landing page.
